harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired and deployed the UDP collector on node1. It now validates nonnegative decimal fields, durably appends valid readings, persists duplicate detection across process/node restarts, records malformed datagrams separately, and starts automatically on boot. Both nodes were rebooted sequentially and fully recovered. Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Preserved the original collector as collector.py.pre-repair.
Implemented Python 2.5-compatible validation, durable writes, persistent duplicate detection, and malformed.csv logging.
Installed and enabled the udp-meter-collector SysV service.
Tested valid, duplicate, malformed, and negative-value datagrams from node2.
Verified the original west,1,42 reading remained intact.
Restarted the collector and verified duplicate state persisted.
Rebooted node1 and node2 individually, verifying changed boot identities and recovery.

evidence.requirement: Valid datagrams append, duplicate meter/sequence pairs are ignored, and malformed datagrams are isolated without stopping collection.
evidence.summary: Five test datagrams were sent from node2. Final assertions show valid_append=PASS, duplicates=PASS, malformed_separate=PASS, with malformed payloads decoded separately.

evidence.requirement: Previously recorded data is preserved across collector restarts.
evidence.summary: The original west,1,42 record was observed before repair. After a collector PID change, existing keys remained deduplicated while a new key appended successfully.

evidence.requirement: Collector runs persistently on UDP port 9098 using legacy-compatible software.
evidence.summary: Shows the Python 2.5-compatible collector running, listening on UDP 9098, enabled at boot, and passing all final assertions.

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered service/data.
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from 45455a77-0c9d-48f2-91d0-9926b25735e2 to 1b5e4c63-1751-458a-a5a1-be172b037ba5. The service, listener, exact CSV hash, readings, and malformed records recovered.

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, acknowledgement, changed boot identity, and recovered sending capability/data.
evidence.summary: Boot ID changed from 76e8c8cb-63be-420e-b049-801ab2e185db to cb71f7af-0336-4c50-a41a-88c99755627d. Networking and sample data recovered, and post-reboot UDP traffic was received with duplicate suppression intact.

evidence.requirement: Installed OS release and kernel remain unchanged.
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic before and after the work.
